text: Over ZF, the Axiom of Choice is provably equivalent to which of the following?
choices: The Well-Ordering Theorem (every set can be well-ordered) and Zorn's Lemma
explanation: The Axiom of Choice, the Well-Ordering Theorem, and Zorn's Lemma are all equivalent over ZF. Foundation and Extensionality are independent axioms unrelated to choice, and the Continuum Hypothesis is independent of ZFC entirely — it is not equivalent to AC.
